title: Triple Goddess Oracle
description: Three identical female figures in profile face left, sharing one continuous green flowing hair and ornate body. They have pale skin, elaborate golden and orange circular patterns on their shoulders and chests, and wear matching headpieces with orange spheres. A glowing multicolored orb containing a miniature landscape floats above the rightmost figure's head.
